mintAuthority.summary: Alchemix V3 native alUSD Alchemists on Ethereum, Arbitrum and Optimism use USDC-denominated MYT collateral. A pinned October 9 census identifies each V3 admin and proxy owner as a 3-of-7 Safe, with separate DAO Guardian and Sentinel roles. Legacy V2 minters are currently unwhitelisted on these three chains, but token-admin reactivation and upgrade powers remain. Exhaustive legacy authorization and Fantom upgrade closure remain unresolved; Metis is a bridge representation.

controls.label: AlchemistV2 (CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: AlToken.ceiling(AlchemistV2) is an administrator-set token mint ceiling; Alchemist collateral and LTV checks further constrain user issuance. The contract cannot raise its own ceiling.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770293, AlToken.ceiling(AlchemistV2) returned 1,000,000,000,000 alUSD and hasMinted returned 21,941,472.558855529... alUSD. The AlchemistV2 proxy used implementation 0x0f17d856ecc7c8ce9bd7d5b3e52a47eca5e8955a; its EIP-1967 admin slot resolved to ProxyAdmin 0xe0fc5cb7665041cda26969a2d1ceb5cd5046347d, whose owner is the separate 3-of-7 Safe 0x9e2b6378ee8ad2a4a95fe481d63caba8fb0ebbf9. The Alchemist cannot raise its own token ceiling; user issuance remains constrained by its collateral/LTV checks.

controls.label: Alchemix MultiSigWalletWithTimeLock (ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770293, AlToken ADMIN_ROLE had exactly two members including this MultiSigWalletWithTimeLock. getOwners() returned seven owners, required() returned 4, and secondsTimeLocked() returned 600 seconds. ADMIN_ROLE can authorize minters and raise their token ceilings but cannot mint directly.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770293, this Safe remained the second of exactly two AlToken ADMIN_ROLE members. It can authorize minters and raise token ceilings; the Alchemist proxy-admin role is separately modeled through ProxyAdmin 0xe0fc5cb7665041cda26969a2d1ceb5cd5046347d, whose owner is this Safe.

mintIncidents.summary: The issuer reported a V1 Alchemist credit-accounting bug affecting users' ability to mint accrued credit. Affected users were reimbursed and the UI added prevention warnings; the immutable V1 contract bug was not upgraded away. This records disclosed historical mitigation, not incident-free current controls.

sources.label: Alchemix Credit Accounting Bug Report, 14 December 2021
Alchemix issuer newsletter confirms affected users compensated

review.evidence: October 9 per-chain census pins V3 Alchemist/Transmuter administration, MYT owner/curator/allocator, DAO Guardian/Sentinel membership, minter whitelist/pause/limits, the known V2 minters, V3 EIP-1967 implementations/ProxyAdmins and Safe owners/threshold/modules/guard. Ethereum block 26154553 is 2026-10-09T11:28:23Z, Arbitrum 513184751 is 2026-10-09T11:38:06Z and Optimism 157973535 is 2026-10-09T11:37:27Z; full hashes and keyless RPC sources are in the controls and lane evidence artifacts. L2 protocol-admin identities now resolve to 3-of-7 Safes rather than unknown contracts. Two L2 V3 minter mechanics now resolve to collateral-constrained paths, without economic hard-cap credit because parameters and implementation are mutable. Known V2 minters are unwhitelisted at these pins but reactivation and legacy upgrade powers remain. The source whitelist mappings are non-enumerable and whitelist setters emit no dedicated membership event; querying known addresses does not prove completeness. The aggregate review therefore remains unresolved. Representation powers stay in Bridge Risk.
unresolvedQuestions: Reconcile every current, stopped and reactivatable token-authorized minter using a complete historical whitelist-setter transaction/internal-call census and pinned membership, not only the three official V3 and known V2 addresses. Resolve the remaining Fantom native token-proxy administrator.

Complete MYT collateral-authority closure, including all strategy owners, extra operators/sentinels, permissioned forwarding selectors, pending/reactivatable paths and the Arbitrum Allocator runtime/source binding. The pinned documented roles and Safe topology alone are not a complete execution-scope certificate.
